subject.title: fix(gateway): enforce plugin-ownership check in sessions.patch

question: After fixing authorization ordering, should ownerless legacy session rows receive a doctor or operator recovery path before plugin-runtime patch access fails closed?
rationale: The cross-plugin ownership fence is required, but denying all persisted pre-ownership rows changes upgrade behavior and requires explicit maintainer security and compatibility intent.

options.title: Fail closed with recovery
options.body: Reject plugin-runtime mutation while adding a tested migration or operator recovery path for legitimate legacy ownerless rows.

options.title: Accept immediate cutoff
options.body: Reject every ownerless row after upgrade and explicitly accept the resulting compatibility and operational impact.

recommendation.title: Fail closed with recovery
recommendation.body: Reject plugin-runtime mutation while adding a tested migration or operator recovery path for legitimate legacy ownerless rows.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history covers both the session lifecycle handler and adjacent plugin-runtime boundary, making this the strongest available decision owner.
